observations.content: Assistant investigated why the OM INDEX showed 'No topics yet': buildWorkerEnv in src/spawn/launch.ts sets OM_MEMORY_DIR to memoryRoot (sandbox root for the consolidator's scoped file tools, design risk 6), plus OM_WORKER role, OM_RUN_ID, OM_RESULT_PATH, OM_COST_PATH.

README of spawned-workers model: agent/index.ts reads OM_WORKER env var; Phase A implements only the 'observer' role, 'consolidator' arrives later; consolidator worker requires OM_MEMORY_DIR set and its output is its .memory/ edits (no result file).

Consolidator worker prompt (agent/consolidator/prompt.ts) tells model to fold observations into topic files under .memory/, has scoped read/write/edit/ls/grep tools confined to .memory/, must not create/edit INDEX.md (generated automatically), maintains JOURNEY.md as APPEND-MOSTLY dated segments, and forbids end-of-session framing phrases like 'by session end'.

Confirmed BUG in agent/consolidator/tools.ts scoped(): resolve(root, '.memory/auth.md') nests one level deeper than 'auth.md' (root/.memory/auth.md vs root/auth.md), even though tool descriptions promise both spellings work; consolidator prompt's 'under .memory/' wording made the model write .memory/foo.md, so topic files landed nested and INDEX (read from root top level) showed 'No topics yet' on 2026-08-30.
Fixed scoped() in agent/consolidator/tools.ts to strip leading './' and '.memory/' prefix before resolving so .memory/auth.md == auth.md, with a doc comment citing the 2026-08-30 'No topics yet' bug.
Added regression test in tests/consolidator.test.ts: '.memory/auth.md' prefix write resolves to memoryRoot/auth.md (not nested) and './.memory/auth.md' reads back the same file.
Completed: bun test passed 108/108 across 15 files in 905ms with 205 expect calls, and bunx tsc --noEmit reported TSC_CLEAN.

Synced fixed files to live .pi/extensions/observational-memory/ and repaired live data: moved 8 topic files plus JOURNEY.md from .memory/01a0522e-81f4-7311-8ba4-027cea97e974/.memory/ up one level to .memory/01a0522e-81f4-7311-8ba4-027cea97e974/ and removed the empty nested .memory dir.

Re-rendered live INDEX.md via a bun one-liner using renderIndexFile + listTopics + atomicWrite + indexPath from the live extension; resulting INDEX.md correctly lists all 8 topic files with summaries (extension-provenance, message-main-bug, observational-memory, paseo-bugs, tool-test-results, user-preferences, workspace-and-environment).
Completed: OM INDEX bug fully fixed end-to-end (code fix + regression test + live data repair + INDEX re-rendered showing 8 topics).

Tested guided-choice spawn: spawned spawn_subagent task 'Reply with the single word GUIDED-OK and stop.' with role worker and NO model; assistant expected an ask_user_question popup but the spawn went straight through without asking.
Child agent 6aab2ec6-0264-4b0b-bf4e-08b0324f54ea (guided-choice-test) finished and replied 'GUIDED-OK'.

Discovered guided-choice path is NOT an ask_user_question popup: index.ts returns a text response telling the agent to re-call spawn_subagent with role/task plus model and thinking, listing available models; since all 5 roles (mermaid-maker, researcher, scout, svg-maker, worker) pin a model in their .md, the guided-choice path is unreachable-by-design today (harmless dead code).

All slash commands register via pi.registerCommand: md-log.ts has pi.registerCommand('md-log', ...) at line 284, and observational-memory registers om:compact, om:consolidate, om:status as commands; whether typing them in the Paseo RPC chat reaches pi as a command invocation is unverified.

Archived 3 test agents via paseo_archive_agent (all success): model-audit 3108961a-a28d-4edf-97e7-35ebc690613c, scan-vision fa19ce57-1733-425d-85a9-67008064ec67, guided-choice-test 6aab2ec6-0264-4b0b-bf4e-08b0324f54ea.

Model audit verdict (151 session files): glm-5.3 has 8 API errors (mostly intentional STOP/PoC) ranked best, best at root-cause diagnosis; glm-5.3-flash has 4 errors, recovers cleanly, cheap, HAS vision but wanders when ambiguous; MiniMax-M3 has 0 API errors and 0 aborts but a FORMAT BUG leaking raw 'thinking' into the text channel ~80% of calls causing Paseo double-parse garbage (the 'not stable' symptom the user saw); deepseek-v4-flash has 4+5 errors, self-recovers, good for cheap observer/probe roles; glm-5.2 not run today.
Recommended switching scout role model from MiniMax-M3 to glm-5.3-flash (clean format + has vision), a one-line change in scout.md awaiting user approval.

Fixed YouTube frames infrastructure: installed yt-dlp, added config '--js-runtimes node' (new yt-dlp needs a JS runtime, the tool did not pass one so URLs came back empty), and switched to BtbN ffmpeg build because the old static build segfaults on DASH streams; 3 frames captured intact.

PDF scan E2E passed: image-only PDF recognized by pdf_info (text=0, image=1), rendered, scout glm-5.3-flash transcribed each line accurately and self-checked 980,000đ; model-override on spawn also verified working.
Verified web_search providers: exa/jina/duckduckgo live; tavily/perplexity need API keys and searxng needs a URL, with clean error messages with guidance.
New discovery: main model glm-5.3 cannot receive images via this provider, so any vision task must delegate to glm-5.3-flash (vision delegation pattern just proven).

Assistant instructed user to type /om:status (expects OM status line) and /md-log (expects session mirror to .md to start) in the Paseo chat to test whether TUI commands pass through Paseo RPC; if they land as plain text that is the conclusion (not a bug).
User asked how the subagent model override works and why the main agent can override an agent profile to spawn a subagent.

When investigating the model override, assistant noted its tool description says the spawn model param is 'Ignored when the role pins a model in its .md', which contradicts having overridden scout (which pins a model) to glm-5.3-flash, so assistant began reading index.ts code to verify precedence.

Spawn code details read: resolveModel(model, available) strictly maps a .md model pin onto a model the machine has (returns undefined if none matches, with MODEL_FALLBACK patterns); providerStringFor(model, providerFamily='pi') returns 'pi/<provider>/<model>' (e.g. 'cli-openai/zaicp/glm-5.3'); spawn guidance tells the agent to pick a [V] vision-tagged model for image tasks since text-only models cannot see images at all, and [XL]/[L] models for longer outputs.
